name: MSGT prepared recording transport
scope: Optional private PPC/ARM optimization. Primary writer ABI4 and MSGT file format3 keep their shapes. PREP2 adds optional RETIRE6; see doc/msgt-recording-retirement.json.

mailbox.word_type: Eight big-endian unsigned32 words per32-byte cache line
mailbox.ownership: ARM initializes before PPC release. Subsequently each side flushes only its own32-byte lines. The side mailbox ends at0x100, where the existing two read mailboxes begin.

operations.1_HELLO: No FAT work. Echo a fresh request sequence and advertise the current slot state.
operations.2_FILE: Prepare this exact nonce/run/capability identity; target must be zero.
operations.3_CANCEL: Cancel this exact run and FILE ownerSequence; capabilities must be zero. Incomplete files are preserved.

phases.5_SYNC: Sync header and first allocated cluster.
phases.6_READY: Synced64-byte file and open FIL are owned by this slot.
phases.7_FAILED: Preparation failed; preserve file and release only by checked background close.
phases.8_CANCELED: Canceled; preserve incomplete file, close in safe background.
phases.9_CONSUMED: Identity was taken by normal START, or its ordinary create fallback owns the identity.

status.1_PROTOCOL: Invalid request or same-ID capability mismatch.
status.3_CONFLICT: A completed source already uses the identity.
status.5_BUSY: A different slot still owns a FIL. Temporary cleanup BUSY does not burn the new reservation or disable warming.

owner_sequence: Response ownerSequence identifies the FILE request associated with the current slot, including after HELLO, CANCEL or BUSY changes response ack. It is not a header checksum. Full headerHash remains in ARM state and is recomputed for the actual START and FENCE.

arm_state.handles: Current writer, prepared next file, and independent bounded retirement FIL. Neither racing read channel nor the recovery state is borrowed. FIL80/DIR72 are the current ARM FatFs layouts.

active_values.2: A failed close still owns the FIL. Do not reset, reuse or zero it. Explicit exact cancellation may retry close; otherwise it remains until boot.

arm_state.cleanup: No unlink or truncate is performed by preparation cleanup. Valid, unexpected and incomplete files are retained. Request receipt has no FAT calls; cleanup is only a guarded background operation.

run_allocation.identity: High-bit ordinary IDs are minted monotonically. Reserving increments nextRun but creates no Draft, PB token, owner token or capture.
run_allocation.consume: Normal arm and checkpoint child creation consume the exact reserved ID; tokens/serials are allocated only by actual Draft arm.
run_allocation.abandon: Consumed/canceled/failed reserved IDs are never reused. An abandoned other-ID warm slot is asynchronously canceled using ownerSequence before preparing the next reservation. Never cancel a current owned run, a pending primary START or a pending checkpoint fork.
run_allocation.manual: An unrelated explicit manual/debug START uses normal creation and leaves the ordinary slot intact. If it consumes the reserved identity, the central allocator skips that identity afterward.

fresh_support.rule: Every producer init clears the HELLO sequence and supported flag, even if all padding already looks valid. A new HELLO sequence is nonzero and different from both observed response ack and previous request sequence; it does not depend on boot tick uniqueness.
fresh_support.accept: Support becomes true only after the matching fresh HELLO echo with the current boot nonce. Invalid/new nonce state invalidates support. The small state is preserved across ordinary startCapture resets, not across producer init.
fresh_support.legacy: An older backend never echoes the fresh probe. Preparation stays disabled, no future Draft/PB token is reserved, and ordinary START remains available. No departure waits for HELLO or PREPARE.

header_and_start.placeholder: Exact current game/version/nonce/run/capabilities,64-byte length, scene0xFFFF, normal buffer size, zeros and valid header checksum. READY requires write plus f_sync, so the first cluster is allocated.
header_and_start.ready_activation: Match nonce/run/capabilities and owned created FIL; require size64 and read back all64 expected bytes. Move FIL/path once to current writer without closing the moved handle. Seek0, write actual scene and recomputed header hash, and resume at byte64.
header_and_start.partial_activation: A received inactive preparation falls through ordinary CREATE_NEW and becomes CONSUMED. An owned0-byte FILE at HEADER can be promoted without a second open. An owned64-byte FILE at SYNC can be checked/promoted before its optional background sync finishes. These partial cases retain ordinary cold/in-flight allocation cost.
header_and_start.failure: Wrong size/header/capability or invalid owner is refused and preserved. A failed activation write retains the file so subsequent DISCARD cannot delete a possible genuine MSTR. No CREATE_ALWAYS is used for traces.
header_and_start.durability: Normal START does not add a mandatory sync. Existing FENCE still syncs before publishing durable prefix receipts, using the new actual-scene headerHash. Chunks, checksums, KEEP/DONE publication, pins, recovery and retained-source validation remain unchanged.

ppc_required: completed setup thread and existing readyForOnlineRace whitelist (normal, safe save box, stable retail pause; fade off, no pending departure, CARD idle)
no mod/practice hold, replay/free camera/TAS ownership or continuation
normal gameplay speed and no current fast-forward
at most0x40000 queued producer bytes, leaving at least0xC0000 total buffer headroom
arm_required: two distinct positive permit heartbeats observed within the freshness interval; stale/missing/revoked permit is not admission
no active read streams, recovery or queued foreground writer/read/branch/export work
DI registers polled before optional work, no DI IRQ or unfinished callback, and at least~250ms since the last disc read
admission.service: One FAT operation per background preparation step; recheck safety between calls. An eligible preparation step precedes optional Bloom work. Dirty canceled/failed close uses the same fresh safe grant. Close is never inherited by an unrelated START.
admission.limit: A FAT call already in progress cannot be safely preempted. Very fast resets, cold/in-flight misses and races may retain fallback latency. No Wii elapsed-time claim follows from host work counts.

busy_and_cancellation: New FILE behind an owned terminal slot receives temporary BUSY identifying the old owner. Background close publishes progress; the client reissues the new exact FILE afterward. BUSY does not monopolize foreground readers/branches and does not make any warp wait. A failed close keeps its detached FIL owned.
unchanged_discard: DISCARD3 is unchanged. Optional RETIRE6 logical acknowledgement is separately documented in doc/msgt-recording-retirement.json.

status_flags.0x100: Pending retirement on version2 only; low8bits retain error status. Unknown flags and version1 retirement flag are rejected.
